visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair pulled back, wearing a white tank top and a grey baby carrier, holds a blue and red Snow White-themed dress. A small child with dark hair in a light blue t-shirt sits in the carrier, clutching a Mario plush toy. The scene is a brightly lit clothing store with aisles and hanging racks. (2) The child looks away with a pout while the woman smiles and speaks. In the background, retail shelves and red 'SALE' signs are visible. (3) The woman holds up a purple striped dress. The camera is handheld, showing slight movement. A male hand holding a hanger enters the frame briefly. (4) A rapid sequence of shots shows different colored dresses (yellow, blue, teal) being presented to the child. The child consistently turns their head away, looking down at the red plush toy. (5) The woman laughs toward the camera as the child maintains a stubborn facial expression. Large yellow variety-show style text appears at the bottom with a glowing effect.
